prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a printed document, focusing on the upper section where the words "Scholarship App" are prominently displayed in bold white text against a deep maroon or burgundy background. The image is tightly cropped, with the top edge of the paper visible and a hint of a wooden surface above it, suggesting the document is lying flat on a desk or table. The lower portion of the image shows part of the next line of text in black on a white background, slightly out of focus due to a shallow depth of field. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the texture of the paper and creating a realistic, tactile quality. The overall composition is minimalistic and documentary in style, emphasizing clarity and the importance of the document, with a neutral, professional mood.
